description:

Job Title: Test Engineer – D&A  
Position: Software Engineer  
Experience: 5+  
Category: Quality Assurance / Data & Analytics Testing  
Main Location: Hyd/Ban/Che  
Position ID: J1126-0410  
Employment Type: Full Time  
  
Position Description:  
We are looking for an experienced Test Engineer – D&A to join our team. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in testing data pipelines, integrations, and analytics outputs. The role requires strong SQL skills, experience in ETL/data testing, source-to-target validation, data quality, and data reconciliation. The candidate should also have experience with Databricks, Spark/PySpark, Python, and APIs. Knowledge of Azure Data Factory, Hadoop/Hive, and test automation would be an added advantage.  
  
#LI-AS26

**Your future duties and responsibilities**

* Test data pipelines, integrations, and analytics outputs to ensure data accuracy and reliability.
* Perform ETL and data testing across different data processing workflows.
* Conduct source-to-target data validation to verify data completeness and accuracy.
* Perform data quality checks and data reconciliation.
* Validate data processing workflows using Databricks and Spark/PySpark.
* Use SQL and Python for data validation and testing activities.
* Test API integrations and data exchange between systems.
* Identify, document, track, and support resolution of data-related defects.
* Support testing activities across data integration and analytics platforms.

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**

Must-Have Skills:  

* Strong SQL skills.
* Experience in ETL and data testing.
* Experience with source-to-target data validation.
* Knowledge of data quality testing and data reconciliation.
* Experience with Databricks.
* Experience with Apache Spark/PySpark.
* Experience with Python.
* Knowledge of API testing and integrations.

Good-to-Have Skills:  

* Experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF).
* Knowledge of Hadoop and Hive.
* Experience with test automation.
* Exposure to cloud-based data platforms and analytics environments.

title: Microsoft Power BI Technical Lead
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

We are a team of nerds dedicated to collect other nerds that happen to be the best in their respective fields in the broadly understood IT service and analytics. Together, we create IT and Analytical Hubs that bring together the best experts from the IT world to help our partners become truly data-driven entities.

Currently, we are looking for a Data Scientist as we support our partner in developing a Global Analytics Unit—a global, centralized team with the ambition to strengthen data-driven decision-making and the development of smart data products for day-to-day operations. The team is designed to foster a data-driven entrepreneurial culture by acting as an incubator to turn ideas into action: creating smart data products across various business domains like sales, marketing, purchasing, logistics, and beyond.

The team has the autonomy to shape their approach, especially in terms of tools, technology, and introducing new concepts and solutions.

Data Scientist

We are searching for a Data Scientist to join our team of top-tier specialists, responsible for applying their expertise in machine learning, data mining, and information retrieval to design, prototype, and build next-generation analytics engines and services.

If you want to:

* Take part in developing and implementing complex smart data solutions.
* Work on bleeding-edge projects with a chance to see your visions come to life.
* Collaborate with world-class IT professionals.
* Work on projects addressing real business challenges in a global and diverse team.
* Have real impact on the projects and environment you work in.
* Propose innovative solutions and initiatives.

Moreover, if you like:

* Flexible working hours and a casual, non-corporate environment.
* Access to benefits such as Multisport, private medical care, and a modern office in the center of Warsaw with good transport links.
* Remote work options as much as you prefer.
* A relaxed atmosphere at work where your passion and commitment are appreciated.
* Vast opportunities for self-development through online courses, certifications, and global knowledge-sharing.

Then this role is certainly a good match!

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Your Responsibilities:

* Understanding business problems and designing smart data products.
* Developing complex models and algorithms to drive innovation within the organization.
* Conducting advanced statistical analysis to provide actionable insights, identify trends, and measure performance.
* Collaborating with data engineers to implement and deploy scalable solutions.
* Working closely with business teams to clarify ambiguous projects into concrete requirements.
* Designing and implementing time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, and demand-sensing solutions for business domains such as sales, marketing, pricing, supply chain, and logistics.
* Partnering with software and full-stack engineering teams to expose models through APIs, dashboards, and scalable user-facing applications that support day-to-day business decisions.

Job Title: Salesforce QA Engineer  
Position: Software Engineer  
Experience: 4+ Years  
Category: Quality Assurance / Software Testing  
Main Location: Hyderabad/Bangalore/Chennai  
Position ID: J1126-0412  
Employment Type: Full Time  
Education Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.  
Position Description:  
We are looking for an experienced Salesforce QA Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in validating Salesforce features, integrations, and releases. The role involves performing functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing to ensure reliable releases and high-quality Salesforce applications. The candidate will collaborate with developers and business teams to identify defects, improve test coverage, and ensure seamless end-to-end business processes.  
  
#LI-AS26

**Your future duties and responsibilities**

* Review business and technical requirements and prepare test scenarios, test cases, and test data.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing for Salesforce applications.
* Validate Salesforce configurations, workflows, Flows, user permissions, and end-to-end business processes.
* Test integrations between Salesforce and external systems, including REST/SOAP API flows.
* Log, track, and retest defects, coordinating with developers and business teams through resolution.
* Support release testing, regression cycles, and production validation.
* Maintain test evidence, execution results, and QA documentation.
* Identify opportunities to improve test coverage and automate repeatable test scenarios.

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**

Must-Have Skills:  

* Hands-on experience in testing Salesforce features and applications.
* Experience in designing and executing test cases for functional, regression, and integration testing.
* Familiarity with Salesforce objects, workflows, Flows, permissions, and business processes.
* Experience with defect tracking and test documentation.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Good-to-Have Skills:  

* Experience in Salesforce test automation.
* Familiarity with Jira, Zephyr, TestRail, or ALM.
* Experience with Salesforce Clouds such as Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Health Cloud, or Experience Cloud.
* Experience working on healthcare projects.
